themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Articles discussing AI agents that can independently perform research tasks, gather information, and make decisions within defined parameters.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Content focused on AI tools that help developers write, debug, and optimize code, including analysis of their effectiveness and security implications.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Publications detailing specific AI tools designed to aid researchers in various stages of the research process, from data analysis to hypothesis generation.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Articles exploring the creation and use of AI-generated user personas or data for testing and research purposes as an alternative to human participants.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Content covering AI capabilities for condensing large amounts of text, such as articles, reports, or conversations, into concise summaries.

themes.name: AI tool evaluation
themes.description: Articles that compare, benchmark, or review the performance and efficacy of various AI tools, often focusing on specific use cases or models.

themes.name: AI for product management
themes.description: Discussions on how AI can assist product managers with tasks such as market research, feature prioritization, and roadmap planning.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Focuses on studies and analyses of how AI chatbots are used by individuals, their effectiveness in different contexts, and potential risks.

themes.name: AI research tools comparison
themes.description: Articles that directly compare and contrast different AI tools designed for research, highlighting their strengths, weaknesses, and performance metrics.

themes.name: AI content generation
themes.description: Publications discussing the use of AI to create various forms of content, including text, images, and even code, for design and research purposes.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
